caption: The drawing depicts a single, carved wooden owl statue placed against a plain, light-colored background. The owl is brown, with darker and lighter shades used to represent the texture and grain of the wood. The owl stands upright on a base made to resemble a roughly textured rock or piece of wood, which shares similar brown hues. The body of the owl displays a repetitive diamond-shaped pattern, mimicking feathers, while the wings and tail show more elongated carvings to indicate feather layers. The owl’s head is turned slightly to the left, with large circular eyes carved in relief, giving emphasis to the eye area with darkened shading. The beak is sharply defined, and short "ear" tufts are present on top of the head. The owl's feet have distinct, pointed talons, gripping the upper surface of the base. The entire drawing is rendered with realistic shading and detailing to emphasize the carved characteristics.
title: Owl
